Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Blithe Acceptance
o Put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire gets +1 stealth. Burn this card if this vampire enters combat. A vampire may have only 1 Blithe Acceptance.

O As above, but this vampire can burn 1 blood when he enters combat instead of burning this card.

What happen if new combat start,do you need to burn this card or blood again,or only need to burn for 1st combat

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Blithe Acceptance
> o Put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire gets +1 stealth. Burn this card if this vampire enters combat. A vampire may have only 1 Blithe Acceptance.
>
> O As above, but this vampire can burn 1 blood when he enters combat instead of burning this card.
>
> What happen if new combat start,do you need to burn this card or blood again,or only need to burn for 1st combat
>
If it's a new combat, the vampire enters a new combat and must burn 1 blood again.
